description:
## Motivation

Binding a handler to a window-level keydown event currently requires raw Phoenix attributes:

```elixir
<div
  phx-window-keydown={"filament:" <> Filament.Hooks.register_event_handler(fn _ -> on_close.() end)}
  phx-key="escape"
>
```

This is verbose, exposes internals, and is inconsistent with how every other event is handled in Filament templates (`on_click`, `on_change`, etc.).

## Proposed API

Add `on_key` as a recognized `on_*` attribute in `Filament.HTMLEngine`. It compiles to `phx-window-keydown="filament:..."` and registers a handler that calls `user_fn.(params["key"])`. Key filtering is done server-side via Elixir pattern matching — no `phx-key` needed.

```elixir
<div class="modal" on_key={fn
  "Escape" -> on_close.()
  _ -> :ok
end}>
```

## Notes

- Window-scope (not element-focus-scope) is the right default for this use case
- Multiple keys handled by one attribute via pattern matching — no per-key attribute name parsing needed
- Fits the existing `on_*` mental model with no new concepts

Depends on the index collision fix (flm-yp7) — without that fix, `on_key` on a component that also has `{for}`-loop handlers would still be broken.
title: Add on_key attribute for window keydown binding
